title: MCP Inspector proxy reachable from any web page without authentication
summary: Anthropic's MCP Inspector ran a local proxy with no authentication between the Inspector client and the proxy, so any page a developer visited could reach it and launch MCP commands over stdio. Oligo Security chained it with the 0.0.0.0-day browser flaw to reach code execution on the developer machine; versions below 0.14.1 are affected.
severity_rationale: CVSS 9.4 unauthenticated code execution on a developer workstation, reachable by drive-by browsing while the tool is running.
